map.灌溉用水计算器，支持不同灌溉方式、作物需水系数与土壤类型调整并估算水费，辅助节水: Irrigation water calculator supporting different irrigation methods, crop water requirement coefficients and soil type adjustments, and estimating the water cost, to help plan water-saving irrigation.
map.灌溉水深 = 计划湿润层深度 × 土壤容重 × (上限含水率 − 下限含水率)；: Irrigation depth = planned wetted layer depth x soil bulk density x (upper water content limit - lower limit); gross water = net water / irrigation water use coefficient; water cost = water volume x unit price
map.按「计划湿润层深度 × 土壤类型持水参数 × 适宜含水量上下限差」估算一次灌水定: Estimate the single-irrigation quota as planned wetted layer depth x soil water-holding parameter x difference between the upper and lower suitable water content limits, then convert it to gross water use by the utilization coefficient of the irrigation method (drip, sprinkler or flood) and estimate the water cost. Crop type and soil type adjust the water requirement and water-holding parameters, helping compare water-saving irrigation options.
map.填写「土壤适宜含水量下限(%)」。: Fill in "Lower limit of suitable soil water content (%)".
map.一次灌水量 = 面积 × 灌水定额（m³/亩）。: Single irrigation volume = area x irrigation quota (m3/mu).
map.全期灌溉量 = Σ各次(ETc − Pe) 折算。: Total irrigation volume = sum over each event of (ETc - Pe), converted.
map.用于配水计划与取水量核算。: Used for water allocation planning and water withdrawal accounting.
map.：面积 20 亩，畦灌定额 35 m³/亩，本次用水 700 m³。若用滴灌可降: : Area 20 mu, border irrigation quota 35 m3/mu, water used this time 700 m3. Switching to drip irrigation lowers it to 15~20 m3/mu, so the same area needs only 300~400 m3, saving nearly half the water.
map.不同灌水方式定额差多少？: How much do quotas differ between irrigation methods?
map.漫灌最高（50+ m³/亩）、畦灌中等、喷滴灌最低（15~25）。节水性滴灌>喷: Flood irrigation is highest (50+ m3/mu), border irrigation medium, sprinkler and drip lowest (15~25). For water saving, drip > sprinkler > surface irrigation, but investment and maintenance costs rise in that order.
map.灌水定额越大越好吗？: Is a larger irrigation quota better?
map.不是。超过田间持水量会深层渗漏流失、浪费水且可能渍根。以『补足到适宜含水量』为度: No. Exceeding field capacity causes deep percolation losses, wastes water and may waterlog the roots. Use "refill to the suitable water content" as the limit; small amounts applied more often beat one heavy watering.
